LEGAL_ADVICE.TITLE_PART_ONE: LegalTech: Advanced Legal Advice Driven by Technology and Innovation

CATHERINE.EDUCATION: She is a lawyer who graduated in 1998 from Universidad del Norte in Barranquilla. She later pursued advanced studies at Universidad Externado de Colombia in Bogotá between 2001 and 2002. In 2017, she completed a program in American Legal English at EF Chicago. In 2020 and 2022, she took courses in Introduction to American English at the University of Pennsylvania and Leadership at the University of Michigan, respectively.
CATHERINE.FORMACION: Lawyer graduated from Universidad del Norte and Universidad Externado de Colombia, with over 21 years of experience in legal consulting and litigation. Throughout my career, I have provided strategic legal advice to prominent companies such as Boccard Colombia SAS, Tenaris-Tubo Caribe Ltda, Hotel Casa del Coliseo, and Hotel Bahía S.A.S. My background includes managing civil, labor, and administrative proceedings as a correspondent attorney for prestigious firms including Chapman & Asociados, Vélez Gutiérrez, and Baker & McKenzie S.A.S.

MIRNA.FORMACION: Bilingual lawyer with experience advising private companies in labor and contractual matters. Background in the judiciary, specifically in Administrative Litigation Law. Currently providing legal services at the law firm Legal Tech Abogados Digitales, focusing on real estate law, horizontal property, and executive proceedings.
